Best food in Saigon
Nov 2024 • Family
Brick and Barrel is a great place. I went a few times when in Saigon. I had the burger and onion rings and pizza the other times. Best flavor. Best burger and onion rings I have had. James H
Hello! I'm sorry to hear about your experience, but it's very confusing to me, as this is the first time any management is hearing about this. Did you tell anyone at the restaurant? We check every single tender that goes out, and have a very specific temp/time that we cook at. Also, our wraps each have a measured 150g of chicken on each one. Looking in to the issue, and watching the video, I see that all of the food was eaten, and I'm wondering why the strips were eaten if they were pink in the middle. If it was pink, we coul have remade it for you without hesitation, and would have even taken it off the bill. 

We do not sell bottled water, because we give away free filtered water... out of a bottle. We're happy to refill bottles for free if you have them. Save the planet, and all, ya know? We try to leave as little waste as we can, and selling bottled water in one-time use plastic is not something we are interested in. I see you had your own bottle, which we would have gladly filled for you for free.

110% ! What a wonderful alternative to Vietnamese food when you’re far from home!
Sep 2023 • Couples
We went here on the strongest recommendation from another couple of travellers in our party and were not disappointed. 
Really good burgers, choice of fries (thin, fat or wedges) amazing onion rings and scrumptious chicken strips along side perfect pizza cooked in an authentic pizza oven. The cocktails were delicious; beers were chilled and staff attentive. 
A special shout out to Anh who was so helpful booking us a cab when the heavens opened. Defo’ above and beyond commitment to her job that she was obviously passionate about. It’s people like her that add to the unique offer at Brick and Barrel. 
One piece of advice: this venue is on the second floor so is accessed via a very narrow doorway that we missed - twice! 
Persevere! It’s well worth the effort to find this gem! So much so, our buddies went the following evening too.

A break from local food the biggest portions ever!!
Aug 2023 • Family
Lovely vibe on open mic night. American food at its best - be warned the portion sides are massive - we hadn’t read that so ordered way to much thinking small Vietnamese size how wrong were we. Chicken strips unless you are a bottomless pit 18 year old boy who can just about manage six chicken strips stick with smaller number. Everything is full chicken breast - one basket of onion rings is enough for a family of four and the poppers are to die for. We’ll done when you need a break from local food come here - it’s rough and ready just what we wanted - we’ll done love it
